title: DAOVerified
tagline: Credentials are private. so the contributor's identity too.
description: The main issue with DataDao is that it is not customisable to satisfy off-chain constraints. After all, what good is on-chain DataDao if we have to broadcast our off-chain identity first!? That's when I realised. "ZKP" is the best way to safeguard data contributors' anonymity while also making it simple for DAO operators to verify. That is the background of ZK-DataDao.
